x: June 12th - Battersea Park - Southern Counties AAA Junior Invitation 440y 1.J.Greatrex (SLH) 50.7, 2.D.Wilkinson (Twick) 50.9, 3.A.Brooks (BELS) 51.2

Another schools area champion was David Wilkinson, throwing 106'0 to win the Westminster schools Javelin. Bob Poole was 3rd in an all Oxfordshire boys race recently and is upholding the name of Belgrave in this locality.

Steve White really impressed in this meeting notching up a 10.5 hundred and a 23.4 furlong - times which speak for themselves. David Wilkinson scored his first points for us in a club match, winning the Javelin by seven feet and also scoring in the Junior match.
Thirty-one members competed in the Ryan Cup for Boys, the winner being Javelin thrower David Wilkinson 3 points clear of Bill Curtin with Bob Williams 3rd.

All the Bels. competing did well but the best of the bunch were David Wilkinson who has great potential in the throws and who placed 3rd in the Javelin and 4th in the Shot, and Bill Curtin looking every inch a champion and winning the 'half' with a devastating last 60 yards.

David Wilkinson had his first outing for some time; having just returned from Germany where he has been living since last summer. Finishing fourth in the Javelin with a personal best throw of 139ft-5" delighted him and now he is looking for some expert coaching to improve still more.
